# Blimpuf Server Rules The following rules are for the Blimpuf Station Space Station 14 server. Violating these rules may result in a warning, a temporary ban, or a permanent ban. You may also be banned from specific roles/jobs/departments. Bans can be appealed in the official Blimpuf Discord server.
Players are also expected to understand [textlink="Metashield" link="BlimpufMetashield"].
If you are ever in doubt as to whether or not something is breaking the rules, feel free to contact the admins via Admin Help or ask on the Discord server.
For in-universe laws and rules check [textlink="Space Law" link="SpaceLaw"] and [textlink="SOP" link="SOP"].
The server is strictly [bold]18+ only[/bold]. (See Rule 2)
## Core Rules
- [textlink="1. Treat other players with compassion and respect." link="BlimpufRule1"] - [textlink="2. Players must speak English and be at least 18 years old." link="BlimpufRule2"] - [textlink="3.
